name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails — an ability that grants protection is not protection
notes: _parseProtectionAbility matched "protection from ..." anywhere in a line, so "{1}{W}: Target permanent you control gains protection from white until end of turn" made Eight-and-a-Half-Tails itself protected from white without the ability being fired, and a white Aura (Holy Strength) was rejected. Only a protection keyword line or keyword-list item counts. Sword of Fire and Ice's static grant line likewise must not protect the Sword, while the equipped Bears still gets the granted bare "Protection from red" / "Protection from blue" lines.
